## PR 439

**Video assembly engine — reels, shorts, image posts (V1 C5.5)**

**বাংলায়:** টেমপ্লেট আর প্রোডাক্ট দিয়ে তৈরির কাজ জমা আর চালানো; আজকের ফল শুধু প্রিভিউ (প্রোডাক্টের আগের ছবি), আসল ভিডিও/ছবি বানানো পরে আসবে

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-11
  - Build status row: video assembly engine (Blueprint C5.2, C5.5 point 2; `@extas/studio/render.ts`, the `SocialRenderJob` table S00's skeleton already carries, `BackgroundStatus`): `queueSocialRender` (`studio.generate`) turns a template + a chosen list of products into a pure `RenderPlan` (scene order, the template's own brand assets grouped by kind, an owner-written caption) and queues a job; `NO_PRODUCTS`/`TEMPLATE_ARCHIVED`/`NOT_FOUND` refuse a bad job up front. `runSocialRenderJob` runs a queued job once (`WRONG_STATE` on a second run) — today's honest scope (Blueprint C5.2: no AI video model here) is a **preview only**: the output is the first featured product's own live lead photo (`ProductMedia.isPrimary`), never a fabricated file; the real compositor (overlay/caption baked into pixels, real video encoding) is a later PR once the server has an encoder, swapped in without touching the plan or the queue. Admin page gains a fourth section, "তৈরি হওয়া কনটেন্ট" (`StudioRenderForm`, template + comma-separated product ids + optional caption, a "তৈরি করুন" button per queued job, thumbnail once SUCCEEDED); `studioHandler`'s POST now picks `studio.write` or `studio.generate` by the action's own prefix. 10 new package tests (5 pure plan-builder, 5 real-PostgreSQL job lifecycle) + 1 new web `.db.test.ts` case (queue → run → reader-denied, through the page's own API)
  - GitHub pull request #115, 11 Nov

  - Settings and named keys: `studio.generate`, `studio.write`
  - Names in the code: `SocialRenderJob`, `BackgroundStatus`, `queueSocialRender`, `RenderPlan`, `NO_PRODUCTS`, `TEMPLATE_ARCHIVED`, `NOT_FOUND`, `runSocialRenderJob`, `WRONG_STATE`, `ProductMedia.isPrimary`, `StudioRenderForm`, `studioHandler`

## PR 440

**Publishing adapters — Facebook Page, Instagram feed/reel/story (part 1) (V1 C5.5)**

**বাংলায়:** ফেসবুক পেজ আর ইনস্টাগ্রামে পোস্ট করার প্রথম ভাগ; কী বসিয়ে টেস্ট পাস না হওয়া পর্যন্ত নকল মোড; নতুন অ্যাকাউন্টে পোস্ট অনুমোদনের অপেক্ষায় থাকে, নিজে নিজে চলতে দিলেই এখন পোস্ট করা যায়

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-11
  - Build status row: publishing adapters, part 1 — Facebook Page, Instagram feed/reel/story (Blueprint C5.1, C5.5 point 3; two new `META`-kind Keys & connections rows, `facebookPagePublish`/`instagramPublish`, each the mock until a Page access token — Instagram also its linked Business Account id — is entered and the Test (reading the Page/account) passes; `@extas/adapters/social-publish`): Facebook's single call `POST /{pageId}/photos`; Instagram's two-step container flow (`/media` then `/media_publish`, no polling — a photo needs none). `@extas/studio/publish.ts`'s `queueSocialPost` (`studio.generate`, plus `studio.publish` when the chosen account runs free) turns a `SUCCEEDED` render job into a `SocialPost`, `PENDING_APPROVAL` by default (CLAUDE.md rule 6) or `PUBLISHING` once the owner has set that account free; `runSocialPost` (`studio.publish`) is the explicit second step that actually calls the adapter, the same queue/run shape as PR 439's render job. Today's honest scope, unchanged from PR 439: every post is the render job's own single preview photo; a real reel/Story/carousel waits for the real compositor. `NOT_SUPPORTED` refuses a YouTube account (PR 441 gives it a real, testable connection but an honest always-refuse on publish — YouTube has no photo-as-video upload). Admin page gains a fifth section, "পোস্ট" (`StudioPostForm`; a "এখন পোস্ট করুন" button once a post is `PUBLISHING`). 4 new adapter-package tests + 5 new studio-package real-PostgreSQL tests + 1 new web `.db.test.ts` case (queue → free the account → run → reader/writer-without-publish denied, through the page's own API)
- **What it does:** Publishing adapters — Facebook Page, Instagram feed/reel/story (part 1) (V1 C5.5) (derived)

- **What was built** (from the Build status row):
  - Code and files: `@extas/adapters/social-publish`, `POST /{pageId}/photos`, `@extas/studio/publish.ts`, `.db.test.ts`
  - Routes: `/media`, `/media_publish`
  - Settings and named keys: `studio.generate`, `studio.publish`
  - Names in the code: `META`, `facebookPagePublish`, `instagramPublish`, `queueSocialPost`, `SUCCEEDED`, `SocialPost`, `PENDING_APPROVAL`, `PUBLISHING`, `runSocialPost`, `NOT_SUPPORTED`, `StudioPostForm`
  - Tests: two new `META`-kind Keys & connections rows, `facebookPagePublish`/`instagramPublish`, each the mock until a Page access token — Instagram also its linked Business Account id — is entered and the Test (reading the Page/account) passes
  - Tests: `NOT_SUPPORTED` refuses a YouTube account (PR 441 gives it a real, testable connection but an honest always-refuse on publish — YouTube has no photo-as-video upload)
  - Tests: 4 new adapter-package tests + 5 new studio-package real-PostgreSQL tests + 1 new web `.db.test.ts` case (queue → free the account → run → reader/writer-without-publish denied, through the page's own API)

## PR 441

**Publishing adapters — TikTok draft + direct, YouTube (part 2) (V1 C5.5)**

**বাংলায়:** টিকটকে খসড়া বা সরাসরি পোস্ট, আর ইউটিউবের সত্যিকার সংযোগ; ইউটিউব ছবিকে ভিডিও বানাতে পারে না তাই স্পষ্ট কারণ দেখিয়ে না করে দেয়, মিথ্যা ভিডিও বানায় না

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-11
  - Build status row: publishing adapters, part 2 — TikTok draft + direct, YouTube (Blueprint C5.1, C5.5 point 3; two new Keys & connections rows, `tiktokPublish` (kind `TIKTOK`) and `youtubePublish` (kind `YOUTUBE`), each the mock until a real access token (YouTube also its channel id) is entered and the Test (reading the TikTok user / the YouTube channel) passes; `@extas/adapters/social-publish`): TikTok's one-shot `POST /v2/post/publish/content/init/` photo post, `post_mode: MEDIA_UPLOAD` (lands as a draft in the owner's TikTok app inbox, a person taps publish) by default and `DIRECT_POST` (straight to the feed) only once the owner flips the account's own `directPostApproved` switch (an attestation that TikTok's app audit already approved direct posting — never a key); `privacy_level` follows the same switch (`SELF_ONLY` / `PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE`). YouTube gets a real, testable connection (`GET /youtube/v3/channels`) but an honest always-refuse on `publishPhoto` — YouTube's API has no photo-as-video upload, so the studio refuses with a clear reason rather than fabricating a fake video from a still photo; `queueSocialPost` now gives that refusal up front instead of the old generic "no adapter yet" message. `saveStudioAccount` gains the `directPostApproved` action (TikTok accounts only, `INVALID_INPUT` on any other platform); the admin page's account row shows a draft/direct toggle for TikTok accounts and explains the difference. 9 new adapter-package tests + 3 new studio-package real-PostgreSQL tests (default draft, direct after approval, the platform guard); no schema change (the `SocialAccount.directPostApproved` column and the `TIKTOK`/`YOUTUBE` `IntegrationKind` values were already in S00's skeleton)
- **What it does:** Publishing adapters — TikTok draft + direct, YouTube (part 2) (V1 C5.5) (derived)

- **What was built** (from the Build status row):
  - Code and files: `@extas/adapters/social-publish`, `POST /v2/post/publish/content/init/`, `GET /youtube/v3/channels`
  - Names in the code: `tiktokPublish`, `TIKTOK`, `youtubePublish`, `YOUTUBE`, `post_mode: MEDIA_UPLOAD`, `DIRECT_POST`, `directPostApproved`, `privacy_level`, `SELF_ONLY`, `PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE`, `publishPhoto`, `queueSocialPost`, `saveStudioAccount`, `INVALID_INPUT`, `SocialAccount.directPostApproved`, `IntegrationKind`
  - Tests: two new Keys & connections rows, `tiktokPublish` (kind `TIKTOK`) and `youtubePublish` (kind `YOUTUBE`), each the mock until a real access token (YouTube also its channel id) is entered and the Test (reading the TikTok user / the YouTube channel) passes
  - Tests: YouTube gets a real, testable connection (`GET /youtube/v3/channels`) but an honest always-refuse on `publishPhoto` — YouTube's API has no photo-as-video upload, so the studio refuses with a clear reason rather than fabricating a fake video from a still photo
  - Tests: 9 new adapter-package tests + 3 new studio-package real-PostgreSQL tests (default draft, direct after approval, the platform guard)

## PR 443

**Comment and DM ingestion from Facebook, Instagram and TikTok into the Support Inbox (V1 C5.5)**

**বাংলায়:** ফেসবুক পেজের পাবলিক কমেন্ট আর ইনস্টাগ্রামের কমেন্ট/ডাইরেক্ট মেসেজ এখন সাপোর্ট ইনবক্সে আসে; পাবলিক কমেন্ট সামনে লেখা থাকে, ইনস্টাগ্রাম নিজের আলাদা চ্যানেলে; এখনো উত্তর বাইরে যায় না, টিকটকের কমেন্ট আনার পাবলিক API নেই বলে বানানো হয়নি

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-12
  - Build status row: comment and DM ingestion from Facebook and Instagram into the Support inbox (Blueprint C5.5 point 5, C10 item 6: Doot's community agent "reads comments and DMs … and routes them into the Support Inbox"; no migration — `SupportChannel.kind`/`Integration.provider` are free strings, and `instagram` was already reserved in `channels.ts`): new `@extas/adapters/social-engagement` (Facebook's `feed` webhook field for a Page's own public comments, and Instagram's own `comments`/`messages` fields, each signed the same X-Hub-Signature-256 HMAC as Messenger/WhatsApp; two new Keys & connections rows, `facebookPageComments` and `instagramEngagement`, kind `META`, each the mock until its Page/app secret passes the Test); `@extas/support/social-engagement.ts`'s `receiveSocialEngagement` (the webhook's own `receiveMessage` caller, PR 425's pattern) routes a Facebook comment into the SAME `messenger`-kind channel as that Page's Messenger DMs (one Page, one app, two webhook fields) and an Instagram comment or Direct message into the Support core's own `instagram` kind, marking every public comment's words with a fixed `(public comment)` prefix so the team never mistakes a reply typed from the conversation for a private one. Two new webhook routes, `/api/social-comments/facebook` and `/api/social-comments/instagram` (GET handshake, signed POST), mirroring `/api/messenger/webhook`'s own shape. `connectors.ts`'s channel-add validator gains `instagram` (`ADDABLE_CHANNEL_KINDS`); the Support settings page's "Add a channel" kind list gains Instagram. Honest scope, two gaps kept visible rather than faked: (1) no outbound sender is added for either kind — a reply typed from a Facebook-comment or Instagram conversation stays `NOT_SENT · CHANNEL_NOT_CONNECTED`, channels.ts's own existing fallback, until a real sending adapter is built; (2) TikTok comment ingestion is **not built** — TikTok's public API has no webhook that hands a third-party app a video's inbound comments (unlike Facebook's and Instagram's own `feed`/`comments` fields), so no row, no switch and no silently-dead code stands in for it; the register and Blueprint keep "and TikTok" in their words for when that API opens. 4 new adapter-package tests (the two parsers, the Page's/account's own echo left out, the catalogue rows, `exclusive: false` so Studio's own Meta connections are never disabled by this kind) + 3 new support-package real-PostgreSQL tests (only a channel added and switched on takes a message, Facebook comments and DMs share one channel correctly marked, Instagram's own channel, duplicates, switched off) + 2 new web `.db.test.ts` cases (both webhook routes' handshake/signature/routing, through the real connection layer)
  - GitHub pull request #180, 12 Nov
- **What it does:** Comment and DM ingestion from Facebook, Instagram and TikTok into the Support Inbox (V1 C5.5) (derived)

- **What was built** (from the Build status row):
  - Code and files: `channels.ts`, `@extas/adapters/social-engagement`, `@extas/support/social-engagement.ts`, `connectors.ts`, `.db.test.ts`
  - Routes: `/api/social-comments/facebook`, `/api/social-comments/instagram`, `/api/messenger/webhook`
  - Names in the code: `SupportChannel.kind`, `Integration.provider`, `instagram`, `feed`, `comments`, `messages`, `facebookPageComments`, `instagramEngagement`, `META`, `receiveSocialEngagement`, `receiveMessage`, `messenger`, `(public comment)`, `ADDABLE_CHANNEL_KINDS`, `NOT_SENT · CHANNEL_NOT_CONNECTED`, `exclusive: false`
  - Tests: two new Keys & connections rows, `facebookPageComments` and `instagramEngagement`, kind `META`, each the mock until its Page/app secret passes the Test)
  - Tests: 4 new adapter-package tests (the two parsers, the Page's/account's own echo left out, the catalogue rows, `exclusive: false` so Studio's own Meta connections are never disabled by this kind) + 3 new support-package real-PostgreSQL tests (only a channel added and switched on takes a message, Facebook comments and DMs share one channel correctly marked, Instagram's own channel, duplicates, switched off) + 2 new web `.db.test.ts` cases (both webhook routes' handshake/signature/routing, through the real connection layer)
